parsed.explanation: The quoted line is a one-sentence label ("Proof via stabilization of minimal elements inside a fixed m") with no argument; the same holds for Theorem A and Lemmas A–C, which are only named. More decisively, the write-up itself states the crux is unresolved: "Remaining crux: prove shrinkage stops (equivalently: finitely many permanents / S_infty finitely generated)" and "Proof of that lemma is in progress". That crux is exactly the ledger's finiteness/large-prime-erasure content (L6.2); support for it is only empirical ("Empirics (100+ values of a_1) ... shrinkage ALWAYS stops"), which cannot be credited. Nothing elsewhere supplies it, so L6.2 is not established; a full lemma-level argument is required.
